title: Retail Sales Officer
description:
**Position Details**

**Position:** Retail Sales Executive  
**Location:** DLF Phase\-1, Gurugram  
**Salary: Fixed B/W \-**  ₹18,000 – ₹30,000 \+ Incentives

**Working Hours:** 10:30 AM \- 8:00 PM

**Position Overview**

Step into the world of fashion jewellery with an exciting opportunity to interact with customers and present stylish, trending pieces. This role is ideal for individuals who enjoy sales, customer engagement, and creating a memorable shopping experience. With a professional retail setup and growth\-oriented environment, it offers a strong platform to build a rewarding career in the fashion jewellery industry. We welcome confident, well\-groomed, and enthusiastic candidates to be part of our team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Greet and engage walk\-in customers with a warm and professional approach
* Understand customer preferences and recommend suitable jewellery collections
* Present and demonstrate products, highlighting design, features, and craftsmanship
* Achieve sales targets and contribute to overall store performance
* Ensure attractive display and proper arrangement of jewellery
* Assist with customer queries, styling suggestions, and service needs
* Coordinate with billing, inventory, and stock management teams

**Requirements**

* Strong communication skills and engaging personality
* Passion for fashion and a good sense of style
* Customer\-focused attitude with jewellery recommendation ability
* Confident, well\-groomed, and presentable appearance
* Knowledge of retail sales and daily store operations
* Team player with a positive and professional approach
* Experience in fashion/jewellery retail (**preferred but not mandatory**)

**Why To Join Us?**

If you are passionate about fashion jewellery and enjoy creating meaningful customer experiences, this is a great opportunity to build a successful career in the retail industry. With a supportive team, performance\-based rewards, and a stylish work environment, you’ll thrive while contributing to a brand that values elegance and customer satisfaction.

**Interview Location**

**Soni Sapphire (Soni Silver Art Jewellery Pvt. Ltd.)**3rd Floor, F\-142, Main Market, Rajouri Garden, Delhi – 110027

**Interested Candidates can share there CV at: 7669331692 or srishtigupta@sonisapphire.in**

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Manager/ Assistant Vice President/ Vice President - Sales, Health & Benefits
description:
**Description**
---------------



**About the team**



Our Health \& Benefits New Business Acquisition/ Sales team specializes in partnering with corporate clients to design, place, and implement comprehensive employee benefit solutions that support workforce wellbeing and business resilience.



We focus on acquiring and advising mid to large corporate clients across a broad spectrum of Health \& Benefits products, including Medical, Accident \& Disability, Term Life, Business Travel, and other employee wellbeing solutions. Our approach combines deep market knowledge, consultative selling, and strong insurer partnerships to deliver tailored, cost‑effective, and compliant benefit programs.



The team works closely with clients to understand their workforce demographics, risk profile, and organizational goals, enabling us to recommend solutions that enhance employee value propositions while supporting long‑term business sustainability. From initial prospecting and solution design to negotiations, placement, and onboarding, we provide end‑to‑end support throughout the client acquisition journey.



With a strong emphasis on collaboration, data‑driven insights, and client experience, our team plays a critical role in driving growth within the Health \& Benefits portfolio while helping organizations build healthier, more engaged, and future‑ready workforces.



**Qualifications**
------------------



* MBA/ Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in related field
* 4\-15 years’ experience in health and benefits sales.
* Demonstrated achievement in B2B sales.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including facilitation of group presentations.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Access and industry\-specific analysis software.
* Basic understanding of the insurance industry, with the ability to become a subject matter expert on the job.
* Innovation and problem\-solving skills that include the ability to develop and propose equipment\-based solutions for clients.

title: Sales Manager
description:
**Sales Manager – Car Detailing (CARHEROZ)**

**Location:** Gurgaon, Haryana (on\-site)

**Company:** CARHEROZ – doorstep car wash, detailing, ceramic coating \& PPF services

**Experience:** 3–5 years in sales (automotive, services, or D2C preferred)

**Job Type:** Full\-time

**About CARHEROZ**

CARHEROZ is a Gurgaon\-based doorstep car care brand offering car wash, deep cleaning, ceramic coating, PPF, and complete car restoration services. We're known for eco\-friendly products, trained detailing "Heroz," and 4\.9★ customer ratings across thousands of bookings.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a hands\-on Sales Manager to drive bookings, build customer relationships, and grow revenue for our detailing and coating services. You'll lead a small sales/booking team, manage lead conversion, and help scale our doorstep service model across Gurgaon.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Drive lead\-to\-booking conversion across calls, WhatsApp, and walk\-ins
* Manage and mentor the sales/customer service team
* Upsell premium services (ceramic coating, PPF, restoration packages)
* Build partnerships with dealerships, corporates, and fleet owners for B2B accounts
* Track daily/weekly sales targets and report performance to management
* Handle customer queries, objections, and pricing negotiations
* Support marketing campaigns with on\-ground sales execution

**Requirements**

* 3–5 years of sales experience, ideally in automotive services, D2C, or local services
* Proven track record of meeting/exceeding sales targets
* Strong communication skills (Hindi \& English)
* Comfortable with CRM tools, WhatsApp Business, and basic reporting
* Prior team\-handling or team\-lead experience preferred

**What We Offer**

* Fixed salary \+ performance\-based incentives
* Growth path into senior sales/business development roles
* Work with a fast\-growing, well\-rated local brand

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: MANAGER - SALES (MapInfo)
description:
**About Lepton Software:**
Lepton Software is a leading provider of **Location Intelligence, Smart Mapping, and GIS\-based software solutions**, empowering enterprises across Telecom, BFSI, Government, Retail, and Automotive sectors. With over **25\+ years of expertise**, Lepton delivers innovative geospatial products, network planning solutions, and enterprise\-grade digital transformation services across global markets. Our culture encourages ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and customer\-centric innovation. **About the Role:**
We are looking for a dynamic and result\-oriented Sales Manager to drive business growth for MapInfo (GIS) solutions at Lepton Software. The role involves managing the complete sales lifecycle, building strong client relationships, and expanding the company’s footprint across key industries. **Key Responsibilities:*** **Revenue Generation:** Drive sales of MapInfo solutions and achieve assigned revenue targets
* **Business Development:** Identify and develop new business opportunities across telecom, utilities, government, and enterprise sectors
* **Sales Cycle Management:** Manage the end\-to\-end sales process from lead generation to deal closure
* **Client Relationship Management:** Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients and stakeholders
* **Product Demonstrations:** Deliver compelling presentations, product demos, and solution pitches
* **Solution Selling:** Collaborate with pre\-sales and technical teams to propose customized GIS solutions
* **Pipeline Management:** Maintain a healthy sales pipeline and provide accurate forecasts and MIS reports
* **Market Intelligence:** Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and evolving customer needs
* **Proposal \& RFP Management:** Prepare proposals, respond to RFPs, and handle commercial negotiations
* **Cross\-functional Coordination:** Work closely with marketing, delivery, and support teams for successful execution

 **Key Requirements:*** Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or related field (MBA preferred)
* 5\+ years of experience in B2B sales, preferably in GIS, IT software, or enterprise solutions
* Strong understanding of GIS tools, preferably MapInfo
* Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets
* Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
* Ability to manage multiple accounts and work independently

 **Preferred Skills:*** Experience in geospatial or location intelligence solutions
* Exposure to telecom, utilities, infrastructure, or government sectors
* Familiarity with enterprise sales cycles and RFP processes
